item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Uhh… is this canon still going? The last post on the discussion was a little over 3 months ago, and the last actual update to the canon was about 2 months ago. When was the last time anything was written here? This canon is a great part of Foundation lore, and super interesting in its own standalone storyline(s). I would love to see more GOC documents written; their own separate ones with the GOC's own unique writing style, classifications and such, and not just rewrites of current SCPs. I mean, there aren't any PTEs, UTEs, Spurious Entries, Non-Threats or even any Persons of Interest. I think LTE-2712-Bosch is an amazing example of how good this could work, and how it can really be an amazing read and canon, unique in its writing style and from the perspective of an organisation with such different aims and methods. I see a lot of potential in this, why don't people come back to it?

item.title: Re: Concerning one of the mentioned "Groups of Interest"
item.content:encoded: Thanks, I knew the mythological context of the objects named, but I just happened to be curious as to any connection between the particular names chosen and their real-world associations with national socialism mirrored in the article.

item.title: Re: Concerning one of the mentioned "Groups of Interest"
item.content:encoded:
Um.

The Spear (or Lance) of Longinus is, in the Christian faith, the weapon that was used to pierce the side of Jesus Christ on the cross.

"Mjolnir" is one spelling of the proper name of the hammer of the Norse God Thor.

I believe (and Clef is welcome to correct me), that the mythological objects are being referred to, not bands drawing their names from the same mythological base.

item.title: Concerning one of the mentioned "Groups of Interest"
item.content:encoded:
First off, I'd like to say hats off to the author, as this truly is a great expansion of Foundation lore.

I did, however, notice one interesting piece of content concerning OBSKURA. While putting aside the lack of mention given to the object in the Foundation's info hub, the two objects supposedly held by OBSKURA had names that caught my eye. As a fan of metal music, I noticed that both "Spear of Longinus" and "Mjolnir" are the names of well-known extreme-right wing/national socialist bands.
I'd usually just ignore this as pure coincidence, but given that the group associated with them is entirely founded on these ideologies, it piqued my interest.

Am I just reading way to much into this (likely), or is this a hidden "nod" or reference of some kind?

item.title: Re: Staff Post - Open

Also, given that three different users made unauthorized edits here, I'm going to lock the page.

Anyone who wishes to add new content to the page should contact DrClef for permission.

item.title: Staff Post - Open
item.content:encoded:
Lots of edits to the page's content has been reverted. Though this page is tagged with "collaboration", it should be noted that it's because all canon hub pages (see here) are tagged with "collaboration", to indicate that any user can write a tale for the canon and link to it here. This doesn't indicate that it's a collaboration in the sense that the page is a free-for-all.

All edits that have been reverted may be added back or edited in with differences by Clef if he so chooses to do so. For more info on what's allowed to be edited onto the page beyond tale links, see this subthread (on page 3 of this thread).
